#set $input_type = 'single' #if str($paired_end) == "true": #set $input_type = 'paired' #end if mkdir -p '$output_dir' && ln -s '${input_reads}' '$output_dir/input.fastq' && ln -s '${input_reads2}' '$output_dir/input2.fastq' &&
#set $profile_dir = '$output_dir/profile' ./art_profiler_454 '$output_dir' '$profile_dir' &&
./art_454 -l ${length} -f ${coverage} -m ${min_length} -M ${max_length} -s ${seed} -i '$output_dir/input.fastq' -o '$output_dir/output' -p '$input_type' -r '$profile_dir' &&
mv '$output_dir/output_R1.fastq' '$output_dir/output_R2.fastq' && mv '$output_dir/output_R1.fastq' '$output_dir/output.fastq' && mv '$output_dir/output_R2.fastq' '$output_dir/output2.fastq' &&
tool.help:
Art 454 Pyrosequencing Simulator ================================
ART_454 is a simulation program to generate sequence read data of Roche 454 Pyrosequencing sequencers. ART generates reads according to the empirical read quality profile and the calibrated error profile of uncall/overcall homopolymers from real 454 read data. ART has been using for testing or benchmarking a variety of method or tools for next-generation sequencing data analysis, including read alignment, de novo assembly, detection of SNP, CNV, or other structure variation.
art_454 can generate both single-end and paired-end of 454 sequencing platform. Besides for regular genome DNA and cDNA sequencing simulation, art_454 also supports amplicon sequencing. The reference sequences can be either DNA or RNA.
Underlying software source documentation: - art art_src_MountRainier_Linux/ART_profiler_454/README: art_profiler_454 is the tool to generate a 454 read profile from 454 sequencing data in the fastq format. USAGE: ./art_profiler_454 input_fastq_files_dir output_profile_dir [fastq_filename_extension] PARAMETERS input_fastq_files_dir - directory containing all 454 read data files in the fastq format output_profile_dir - directory to put read profile files generated by the program - art art_src_MountRainier_Linux/ART_profiler_illumina/README: This tool is to create an ART illumina read quality profile from Illumina sequencing data in multiple fastq or gzipped fastq files USAGE: ./art_profiler_illumina output_profile_name input_fastq_dir fastq_filename_extension [max_number_threads] PARAMETERS: output_profile_name: the name of read quality profile to be generated input_fastq_dir: the directory of input fastq or zipped fastq files fastq_filename_extension: fastq or gzipped fastq filename extension max_number_threads:: maximum number of threads/cores to be used for the run (default: all cores)
